propositions: attach_commits rejects valid code commit SHAs when REBAR_TRACKER_DIR points outside the code checkout because code_root_for incorrectly derives the code repository from dirname(tracker_path)
git -C operations during SHA validation are executed against the tracker parent directory instead of the actual code repository root, causing valid commits to be marked unresolvable

Resolving commit validation must use an explicit repo_root parameter (or REBAR_ROOT, or cwd Git top-level) independent of tracker storage location, while tracker reads/writes continue through REBAR_TRACKER_DIR
The functions code_root_for and unresolvable_shas have only one production call site (from attach_commits) and should be removed after migration to explicit repo_root validation
Unknown/bogus commit SHAs must remain rejected with all-or-nothing semantics, and default in-repo tracker behavior must be preserved
